verdict.rationale: Financial Connections is API-driven and has some automation-friendly pieces. Stripe documents an official CLI (probe-5), and the product's use-case page lists a Link CLI for agent-driven balance and transaction monitoring (docs-11). Test mode lets a client link Stripe-managed test institutions without credentials (docs-15, docs-26), and webhooks report refresh completion (docs-12, docs-13). However, the core account-linking step is an interactive client-side authentication flow launched via collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts (docs-6), and nothing shows the full flow running non-interactively in CI. Missing for 10: a documented headless/CI recipe for account linking, explicit Stripe CLI commands for Financial Connections, Link CLI usage details, and hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
